safe_shim_observations.interpretation: The safe shim exports WHY3LIB and WHY3DATA to bundle-relative locations, but the exact Debian Why3 1.8.0 binary still reports compiled-in absolute /usr libdir/datadir. The overrides do not relocate these printed paths in this build. Since the plugin loader points outside the candidate bundle, proof/config commands were not invoked.

conclusion.detail: The validation-only candidate is structurally safe to extract as non-root, and Why3 --version works. However, --print-libdir and --print-datadir remain compiled-in host paths despite bundle environment overrides. The safe shim correctly refuses config/proof commands with exit 2. Do not promote T2/T3/T4/T5.
